name: Garland Events
summary: A wedding planner's desk for mehndi, barat and walima nights, with a seating plan and a live run sheet
about: A ten-page desk for a small Lahore wedding planner running several weddings at once, in ivory, deep maroon and old gold, with a dark barat-night theme. Drag families onto round tables to build the seating plan, and watch the day-of run sheet light up the current step while the next one counts down. Calendar, venues, vendor quotes side by side, guest RSVPs, budgets in rupees with advances, and tasks all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Open a page from the pill bar: Overview, Calendar, Venues, Vendors, Guests, Seating, Budget, Run sheet or Tasks
On Seating, drag a family onto a table, or pick one and press a table; Seat the rest fills the gaps by family
On Run sheet, watch the clock walk the night, mark a step done, push the rest back 10 minutes or speed it up
Compare vendor quotes side by side and accept one to book it into that wedding's budget
Change a guest's reply right in the table, send reminders, and record payments against each booking
Click a day in the calendar or a function to open it, and add, edit or delete functions
Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, and reset the demo data in Settings
